en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a street scene in front of an Ottoman-style stone fountain built into the wall of a building. The fountain has an arched niche and a spout at street level where people, including children and a man with a donkey, are gathered. Cobblestones cover the street. To the right is a tall wall with a gate. Printed captions appear below the image indicating the subject is a Turkish fountain, along with the publisher's details.
